Description

Implement GoThru Single Sign-On (Keycloak) authentication for the Street Builder desktop application (Tauri v2 + React 19). This provides a seamless authentication experience with OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE (S256), system browser authorization, custom deep-link callback (street-builder://auth-sso), interactive verification modal, and 360° planetary lens completion screen.

Key Changes

  1. Dynamic Feature Flag:
    • Queries GET https://apil.gothru.co/v1/feature-flags?env=dev|live.
    • When keycloak_auth: true, renders the branded "Login with GoThru" SSO button.
    • When keycloak_auth: false, falls back to manual email/password and Google OAuth.
  2. SSO Button & Card Design:
    • Branded Street Builder dark card (#19191b, border #2a2c30, logo, title, and description).
    • Custom #4b9cbf SSO button with white tile containing the official GoThru icon.
  3. Interactive Verification Modal (SsoProgressModal.tsx):
    • In-Progress Stage: Halo disk (148px) with rotating progress arc and cloud icon.
    • 4-step progress stepper:
      1. Checking connection
      2. Preparing secure sign-in
      3. Finalizing setup
      4. Almost there...
    • Completed Stage: SVG 360° Planetary Lens with rotating panorama, orbital ring, orbiting dot, confetti, stars, and green tick badge.
    • 2-second hold on the success screen before entering the workspace.
  4. Backend (Tauri v2 + Rust):
    • Added street-builder deep-link scheme (street-builder://auth-sso).
    • Native Rust token exchange command sso_exchange_token to bypass Keycloak CORS.
    • Backend session persistence via login_sso saving to session.json (SessionStore).
    • Updated deep-link URL parsing in Rust to prevent routing conflict with legacy Google login.
    • Added @tauri-apps/plugin-http / tauri-plugin-http with GoThru domain permissions.

Testing & Verification

  • pnpm lint: All files formatted and passed ESLint / Prettier.
  • pnpm test: 126 unit tests passed (including PKCE hashing, JWT decoding, and redirect URL parsing).
  • pnpm build: TypeScript typecheck and Vite production build passed without errors.
  • cargo check & cargo clippy --workspace: Rust backend compiled cleanly with 0 warnings.
  • cargo test: All 140 core library tests passed.

Result from Developer

Update: Implementation Summary

Keycloak SSO implementation is complete and ready for review:

  1. Frontend & UI Implementation:

    • Integrated dynamic feature flags via GET https://apil.gothru.co/v1/feature-flags?env=dev|live.
    • Built branded dark login card and custom "Login with GoThru" button (#4b9cbf) with white GoThru icon tile matching Image 1.
    • Built SsoProgressModal.tsx featuring the 148px halo ring with Cloud icon and 4-step progress stepper matching Image 2:
      • Step 1: Checking connection
      • Step 2: Preparing secure sign-in
      • Step 3: Finalizing setup
      • Step 4: Almost there...
    • Implemented completed success screen with 360° Planetary Lens SVG animation (rotating panorama, glowing orbital ring, orbiting dot, confetti burst, twinkling stars, green checkmark badge) with 2-second hold before entering workspace.

  2. OAuth 2.0 PKCE & Deep Link Flow:

    • Full PKCE (S256) implementation in src/features/auth/services/keycloak.ts.
    • System browser opener via @tauri-apps/plugin-opener.
    • Deep link callback handled via street-builder://auth-sso.
    • Dual-storage context mirror (sessionStorage + localStorage) and code deduplication to prevent double processing.

  3. Backend Rust & Security:

    • Added sso_exchange_token command in Rust with host allowlist validation to exchange authorization code without CORS restrictions.
    • Added login_sso command to persist session directly into session.json (SessionStore).
    • Refined parse_oauth_redirect to ignore auth-sso URLs so they do not conflict with legacy Google login deep links.
    • Configured tauri-plugin-http capabilities for GoThru API.

  4. Testing & Quality Assurance:

    • Unit tests added in src/features/auth/__tests__/keycloak.test.ts (100% pass).
    • Rust automated tests passed (cargo test --lib).
    • Code formatting and ESLint clean (pnpm lint).
    • Frontend and backend builds verified (pnpm build & cargo check).
